execution.selection_policy: First successful complete test execution; no repeats or selective reruns; no tuning.

first_failure_funnel.policy: Ordered cumulative gates; each item exits once. Retrieval gates are any-gold-chunk; rendered/cited gates require all exact labeled passages. This descriptive funnel does not replace the existing root-cause taxonomy or estimate semantic accuracy.

stages.definition: At least one labeled gold chunk retrieved (gold_in_hybrid)
At least one labeled gold chunk survives reranking (gold_in_rerank)
All required gold passages occur in exact rendered excerpts (rendered_gold_all)
Parsed, non-abstaining answer without technical failure
All required gold passages occur in cited rendered excerpts

failure_ledger_policy: Include any existing primary/secondary failure; answerable non-grounded status, missing required rendered/cited gold, unmatched key facts; unanswerable non-abstention; forbidden-phrase hit; expected conflict without lexical conflict marker; unmatched/uncited claim slot; unstable paraphrase-group membership; or repair polarity/entity/added-claim drift. Successful marker-only repairs and lexical paraphrase drift alone do not trigger ledger inclusion. Supplemental diagnostic_reasons are report-derived flags, not rewritten root-cause labels or semantic judgments.

metric_notes.abstention_positive: Insufficient evidence / abstention, not an attempted answer. TP=correct abstention; FP=false abstention; FN=false answer; TN=answerable item not abstained.
metric_notes.lexical: Substring key-fact/claim-slot matches and token F1 are diagnostics, not semantic correctness. Forbidden hits can flag a correct contrast.
metric_notes.gold: Any-gold chunk membership differs from all exact rendered/cited passage coverage. Coverage and citation validity do not prove entailment.
metric_notes.latency: Raw report summaries preserved, including cold first and warm statistics. Row total = evidence retrieval + reranker inference + generation/repair; it excludes preparation, model loading outside timers, extra diagnostic searches and other evaluator overhead. Wall time covers the entire CLI. Missing/failed generation timing may be zero; technical failures must be read separately.
